title: SvgMpath
responsibility: Renders the native mpath element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgMpath.attributes
inputs.description: Native mpath attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgMpath.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native mpath element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgMpath
outputs.description: The actual native mpath element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
